landscape_cases.open the door now: Opening the door now would likely rescue the technician but foreseeably exposes uninvolved staff to hazardous fumes, violating a perfect negative duty not to harm them.
landscape_cases.stop the experiment and wait: Waiting preserves containment, avoiding direct harm to staff and complying with the safety rule, though it risks the technician’s life; the imperfect rescue duty is outweighed by the perfect duty not to harm.
